hooks.name: Citation verification reminder
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to verify citations and update the verified-PMID test list whenever the knowledge base changes.

action.prompt: The clinical knowledge base was edited. Before accepting the change: verify every new or changed citation against PubMed (NCBI E-utilities esummary) or the official guidance page, confirm the URL contains the PMID, update VERIFIED_PMIDS in src/clinical/clinical.test.ts and docs/CITATIONS.md, and check the entry against .kiro/steering/clinical-safety.md. Never add a citation that has not been verified.
